name: Tesseract Native Result
description: Inspect a complete native Tesseract result while retaining exact objects and absent dynamics.

inputParameters.name: result
inputParameters.description: Exact TesseractPlanningResult from Tesseract Native Plan.

outputParameters.name: request
outputParameters.description: Exact TesseractPlanningRequest that produced this result.

outputParameters.name: native_result
outputParameters.description: Exact native tesseract_robotics PlanningResult with full native access.

outputParameters.name: raw_program
outputParameters.description: Exact raw native CompositeInstruction returned by the pipeline.

outputParameters.name: trajectory_points
outputParameters.description: Exact native TrajectoryPoint objects in result order.

outputParameters.name: joint_names
outputParameters.description: Consistent native joint-name order used by every convenience row.

outputParameters.name: positions
outputParameters.description: Grasshopper tree with one native-unit position row per trajectory point.

outputParameters.name: velocities
outputParameters.description: Grasshopper tree with one native-unit velocity row per point, or None when absent. Never zero-filled.

outputParameters.name: accelerations
outputParameters.description: Grasshopper tree with one native-unit acceleration row per point, or None when absent. Never zero-filled.

outputParameters.name: times
outputParameters.description: Native time-from-start seconds in point order, or None when absent. Never zero-filled.
